174 Exploring Society: India and Beyond Governance and Democracy Introduction Earlier chapters have shown us how, in a democracy, good governance aims to empower the citizens so they may actively participate in their country’s functioning, whether it is at the rural, regional, urban, state or national level.
This is the broader concept of participatory democracy.
